name: ForgetCoin
tagline: Losing your seed phrase has never been this lucrative.

hero.headline: The first blockchain built on collective amnesia.
hero.subtext: Join 420,000 verified password-forgetters in our revolutionary decentralized ecosystem of helplessness.

features.title: Proof-of-Forgetting
features.description: Our proprietary consensus mechanism validates transactions only from wallets whose owners cannot remember their password. True decentralization through selective incompetence.

features.title: Immutable Support Ticket Ledger
features.description: Every 'I lost my seed phrase' ticket is permanently recorded on-chain, creating an immutable monument to human error at scale.

features.title: Zero-Knowledge Confusion
features.description: Advanced ZK proofs allow you to prove you've forgotten something without revealing what you've forgotten. Cutting-edge privacy through ignorance.

whitepaper.abstract: ForgetCoin (FORG) represents the world's first cryptocurrency ecosystem built entirely around the phenomenon of credential loss. We have identified a $4.2 trillion addressable market in inaccessible crypto wallets and propose to monetize collective human forgetfulness through blockchain technology.
whitepaper.problem: Approximately 20% of all Bitcoin is permanently lost due to forgotten passwords, lost seed phrases, and deceased owners who never shared their keys. This represents a catastrophic waste of digital assets. Traditional solutions such as 'writing it down' have proven inadequate, as paper is losable.
whitepaper.solution: ForgetCoin introduces a novel Proof-of-Forgetting (PoF) consensus mechanism. Rather than fighting forgetfulness, we embrace it as a core feature. Each forgotten password creates a new block. Each locked wallet contributes to our total value locked (TVL). Losing is winning.
whitepaper.tokenomics_text: FORG has a total supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens. 40% is permanently burned (accidentally), ensuring deflationary pressure. The team holds 20% in a wallet whose password has been stored in a location described only as 'somewhere safe.' Marketing receives 15% to spread awareness of our revolutionary forgetting technology.
whitepaper.risks: Investors should be aware that the primary risk of FORG is the same as its core thesis: you may forget you own it. Secondary risks include: regulatory clarity (we forgot to check), smart contract audits (scheduled for Q4, date forgotten), and the possibility that our entire technical approach is a parody. It is.
whitepaper.conclusion: ForgetCoin stands at the intersection of human psychology and decentralized finance. By transforming forgetfulness from a bug into a feature, we unlock unprecedented value in the attention economy of people who have forgotten what they were doing. Together, we forget. Together, we moon. Probably.
